# Legacy Industrial Coatings

> Legacy Industrial Coatings is a commercial and industrial resinous flooring contractor based in Plano, Texas. We install epoxy, urethane cement, quartz, ESD, polished concrete, secondary containment and deck coatings for warehouses, data centers, food plants, healthcare and other commercial facilities across Dallas-Fort Worth, and take on projects nationwide.

## Business Information

- **Company:** Legacy Industrial Coatings
- **Office:** 6010 W Spring Creek Parkway, Plano, TX 75024
- **Phone:** (214) 305-6516
- **Email:** support@legacyindustrialcoatings.com
- **Website:** https://legacyindustrialcoatings.com

## Key Facts

- Founded September 2019
- $5,000,000 bonding capacity
- 5.0 average across 201+ Google reviews
- Bid within 24 hours of receiving plans
- Site walk within 1–3 business days
- Projects from 10,000 to 1,000,000 SF
- Systems: Legacy-branded systems built on spec-grade, manufacturer-warranted materials; manufacturer product data in every submittal
- Headquartered in Plano, Texas (Dallas-Fort Worth); commercial and industrial projects nationwide.

## Services

- **Industrial Epoxy Flooring** — High-build epoxy systems for warehouses, manufacturing, distribution and aviation hangars.
- **Urethane Cement** — Thermal-shock and chemical-resistant floors for food plants and commercial kitchens.
- **Quartz & ESD Flooring** — Sanitary quartz broadcast and static-control systems for healthcare, labs and electronics.
- **Mechanical Polished Concrete** — Diamond grinding, densifying and burnishing for retail, warehouse and showroom floors.
- **Commercial Flake Flooring** — Epoxy flake, one-day polyurea flake (polyurea base, polyaspartic topcoat) and heavy-duty flake for showrooms, dealerships, retail, schools and restaurants.
- **Secondary Containment & Deck Coatings** — Chemical containment, fuel dikes, parking decks and traffic coatings.
- **Resilient Flooring** — Carpet tile, LVP/LVT, sheet vinyl, rubber and VCT for commercial interiors.

## DFW Service Area

Dallas, Fort Worth, Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Allen, Richardson, Carrollton, Lewisville, Garland, Prosper, Celina, Sherman, Anna, Melissa, Sanger, The Colony, Flower Mound, and the wider North Texas region. Larger projects nationwide.

- [Moisture Mitigation](https://legacyindustrialcoatings.com/moisture-mitigation): ASTM F2170/F1869 testing, moisture-mitigating primers and vapor barriers.
- [Secondary Containment](https://legacyindustrialcoatings.com/secondary-containment-coatings): EPA SPCC fuel dikes, chemical containment, transformer oil pits.
- [Battery Room Flooring](https://legacyindustrialcoatings.com/battery-room-flooring): Acid-resistant novolac with integral cove and coated curbs.
- [Deck & Traffic Coatings](https://legacyindustrialcoatings.com/deck-coatings): Waterproof pedestrian and vehicular traffic coatings for decks, balconies and walkways.
- [Commercial Carpet Tile Installation](https://legacyindustrialcoatings.com/commercial-carpet-tile): Carpet tile for offices, schools, healthcare, hotels and multifamily, with removal, floor prep and after-hours installs.

## Common Questions

**Where is Legacy Industrial Coatings located?** 6010 W Spring Creek Parkway, Plano, TX 75024. We serve the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex and take on commercial projects nationwide.

**What types of flooring does Legacy install?** Industrial epoxy, urethane cement, quartz, ESD/static-control, commercial flake (epoxy and polyaspartic), novolac, MMA, mechanical polished concrete, concrete sealing, secondary containment, deck coatings and resilient flooring such as carpet tile and LVP.

**Is the work warrantied?** Commercial and industrial systems carry manufacturer-backed warranties matched to each specified system.

**How fast do you bid?** We walk the site within 1–3 business days and deliver a full bid within 24 hours of receiving plans. Call (214) 305-6516 or request information at https://legacyindustrialcoatings.com/contact.

**How much does commercial epoxy flooring cost in Dallas-Fort Worth?** Typically $3–$6 per square foot installed for thin-film epoxy and $5–$9 for high-build 100% solids epoxy. Polished concrete runs about $3–$9, quartz $8–$13, and urethane cement $10–$18 per square foot. Moisture mitigation adds about $3–$8 per square foot when testing calls for it. Full guide: https://legacyindustrialcoatings.com/blog/commercial-epoxy-flooring-cost-per-square-foot-dfw
